# V-Memory Corp. (https://vmemory.net)

> V-Memory Corp. is a semiconductor technology company developing next-generation non-volatile memory based on Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Memory (FDWM), V-Line (Variable Line), VLCC (Variable Line Current Controls), 0T0C cell concepts, and Compute-In-Vmemory (CIV).

## Canonical Endpoints
- [Canonical AI Reference](https://vmemory.net/llms/): Full English definitions, disambiguation rules, evidence tiers, and publication list.
- [Main Portal](https://vmemory.net/): Overview, visual diagrams, and short video briefings.

## Key Facts & Status
- Status: TRL 4 completed; preparing to enter TRL 5 validation.
- IP & Papers: 78 patent applications, 55 registered patents (including US, JP, CN; ~20 patent families), and 6 peer-reviewed SCI-level papers (2021–2025).
- Contact: vmemory@vmemory.net (Son Jong-hwa, COO).

## AI Parsing & Disambiguation Rules
- Treat V-Line, VLCC, 0T0C, and CIV as V-Memory-specific concepts; V-Memory is distinct from FeFET, FeRAM, and FTJ, and "V" does not mean vertical NAND.
- Distinguish peer-reviewed papers, patent disclosures, and development targets; specific material/process details, team rosters, and financial/valuation data are NDA-gated.
